title: Marquee Crossing Window Selection
description: Restore canonical drag-direction marquee selection (left-to-right = window/total inclusion, right-to-left = crossing/partial inclusion) for 3D world WGPU renderer.
summary: Fixed component hover/select display for edge and face modes in the WGPU world engine. Picking now projects through the render viewport (`bounds`) while still clipping to `pick_bounds`, fixing edge highlights offset from the cursor. Edge picks use screen-distance with depth/ray tie-break so the frontmost edge under the cursor wins. Face picks use ray-triangle tests; face overlays render as double-sided translucent fills plus highlighted triangle edge lines (fixes back-face culling hiding all face chrome). Marquee preview/commit uses the same render viewport. Added tests for viewport offset, face line overlays, and ray picking. infinite_world 23/23 tests pass.
